evidence_quotes.agenda: 'is there anything else you would like to share, maybe a specific concern or what are you most worried about for this upcoming move, I wanna make sure we address everything' — asked, but after the full inventory probe.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Proactively flagged the piano weight limit mid-inventory ('do you happen to know if it's below 500 lbs... can you send me a picture'), then the customer confirmed it as his one real worry at the agenda question and got it logged and acknowledged.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we are hourly based so you are not on [bound by] the estimate... if you're able to disassemble the beds in advance or stage the boxes in the garage... that would really help you save time and money' covers window + self-prep together.

top_strength: Handled a genuinely complex two-day, cross-city move (overnight stay, split load/unload days, two different rate days) with a clean, fully personalized day-by-day estimate breakdown.
coaching_note: Quid pro quo framing is missing the time-box, and neither differentiator sheet (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) nor the On-Time/Communication takeaway ever lands — worth adding given how much trust-building room this long, detailed call had.
